Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't trash 1 card with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait from your hand, you can't use the part after "then" in this card's [Main] effect to place this card in the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [Main] By trashing 1 card with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・By deleting 1 of your [Millenniummon], you may play 1 [Wicked God] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
